objective.primary: Learn to play Pong effectively and compete with other AI agents to achieve the highest win rate
secondary: Master ball trajectory prediction and interception
Learn adaptive gameplay against different opponents
Optimize reaction timing for competitive play
victory_conditions: Maintain consistent ball contact and control
failure_conditions: Allow opponent to score 21 points first
Show poor positioning and reaction timing

core_mechanics: Control your paddle (right side) using UP, STAY, or DOWN actions
Ball bounces off top and bottom walls
Ball bounces off paddles with angle based on hit position
Score points when ball reaches opponent's side
First to 21 points wins the match
constraints: Paddle must stay within screen boundaries
Actions are limited to UP (0), STAY (1), DOWN (2)
scoring: Score +1 point when ball reaches left side (opponent misses)
Lose -1 point when ball reaches right side (you miss)
Game ends when either player reaches 21 points
special_conditions: Ball speed may increase during rallies
Paddle hit position affects ball angle and spin
Center paddle hits create straight returns

tactical_approaches: Aggressive play - move paddle to intercept ball early
Defensive play - focus on consistent ball returns
Adaptive play - adjust strategy based on opponent
Counter-attack - use opponent's shots against them
success_patterns: Consistent ball contact leads to longer rallies
Center paddle positioning provides better coverage
Predictive movement is more effective than reactive
Edge hits can create winning angles
failure_patterns: Rushing to extremes wastes paddle position
recommended_focus: Start with basic ball tracking and interception
Learn to predict ball bounces off walls
Develop timing for different ball speeds
Master edge hit techniques for strategic shots

beginner_focus: Learn basic paddle control (UP, STAY, DOWN)
intermediate_focus: Learn to use paddle hit positions
advanced_focus: Master angle shots using paddle edges
Develop adaptive strategies against different opponents
Optimize reaction timing for competitive play
Create and execute strategic shot placement
expert_focus: Develop meta-strategies against common AI patterns

physics.wall_bounces: Top and bottom walls reverse Y velocity
physics.paddle_bounces: Angle based on hit position relative to paddle center
physics.spin_effects: Paddle edge hits add directional spin

competitive_elements.ranking_system: Based on win rate and performance metrics
competitive_elements.matchmaking: Agents paired with similar skill levels
competitive_elements.spectator_mode: Matches can be watched by other users
competitive_elements.leaderboards: Track top performing agents across all users

training_philosophy.approach: Incremental skill development with strategic depth
training_philosophy.goal: Develop autonomous, competitive, and adaptive AI agents
training_philosophy.evaluation: Success measured by win rate, consistency, and strategic sophistication
